title: Billionaire Mark Cuban to Gen Z: Listen to Jeff Bezos’ advice; just get a job
content: Mark Cuban advises young workers to seek any job to gain practical experience and manage workplace expectations. Both Cuban and Jeff Bezos believe that initial employment develops valuable skills like responsibility and teamwork. They highlight the importance of understanding how businesses operate and contributing to productivity. Early jobs can serve as stepping stones for future career advancement and personal growth in professional settings.

title: Arkansas woman wins $183,000 business share after four divorce appeals
content: Following their divorce in 2017, a couple in Arkansas found themselves embroiled in a lengthy legal dispute concerning their jointly owned business, Groundskeeper. Conflicts emerged regarding the business's valuation and tax obligations. The Arkansas Court of Appeals confirmed the wife's claim of $183,000, inclusive of prejudgment interest from the divorce date, mandating Craig Ballegeer to acquire his former wife's half-interest in the business.

title: Republicans feel the blues as US midterms begin: Key races and faces to watch
content: Current polling trends show that Republicans might encounter difficulties during the midterm elections on November 3, largely due to dissatisfaction among voters. This election is being viewed as a crucial test of the government's performance on vital topics including the economy and immigration. As both House and Senate races remain hotly contested, the results are far from certain, with Democrats aspiring to take advantage of this discontent.

title: Giannis' foundation turns discarded fishing gear into 80 basketball nets
content: In a remarkable initiative, the Charles Antetokounmpo Family Foundation and Enaleia have repurposed discarded fishing gear into vibrant basketball nets, enhancing public courts across Athens. This project not only replaces damaged nets but also tackles marine pollution by transforming waste into valuable resources for the community. Young athletes can engage with these recycled nets, fostering a sense of environmental awareness alongside their love for sports.

title: Scientist builds mini universe of 24k atoms to show time can be measured without a clock
content: At the University of Birmingham, Giovanni Barontini has crafted a captivating mini universe using 24,000 chilled rubidium atoms. This groundbreaking experiment reveals that time can be gauged via entropy variations, offering a fresh perspective beyond traditional clocks. The model aids in probing the inconsistencies between general relativity and quantum mechanics in timing measurements.

title: 'There are no words': Messi, Mbappé lead football's tributes to Jesús de Miguel
content: In a tragic incident, Jesús de Miguel, a forward for CD Tenerife, passed away following a collision with FC Andorra's goalkeeper Jesús Owono during a second-division match. This collision led to cardiac arrest. The football community expressed its sorrow, and Spanish authorities have launched an investigation. The match was called off, and other games were postponed in his honour.

title: Ladakh admin asks Sonam Wangchuk's school to halt activities amid pending HC case
content: The Ladakh administration on Tuesday issued a notice to the Himalayan Institute of Alternatives (HIAL), founded by Sonam Wangchuk, asking it not to undertake any further activities at Desert Flower School in Phyang until the matter is decided by the High Court of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.

title: Connor McDavid vs Sidney Crosby: Inside the NHL stars' luxury homes
content: Connor McDavid and Sidney Crosby have established different approaches to luxury living away from the NHL spotlight. McDavid’s reported Edmonton mansion reflects contemporary design, personalised spaces and entertainment-focused amenities, while Crosby’s Nova Scotia lakefront retreat is associated with privacy, nature and a quieter lifestyle. The homes they covered give a glimpse into how two famous NHL captains value comfort outside of hockey.

title: Stephen Curry makes $2.5 million profit from $11 million San Francisco property
content: Stephen Curry has sold his San Francisco commercial property for $11 million, making a $2.5 million gross gain after purchasing it for $8.5 million in 2024. The building was originally intended to become the headquarters of his business venture, Thirty Ink. However, a dispute with the Carpenters Union forced him to abandon the project in 2025. The property has since found a new buyer linked to the artificial intelligence industry.

title: Widow faces tax notice for Rs 60 lakh cash deposits; why ITAT gave ‘gift’ relief
content: The Income Tax Department discovered that a woman had deposited Rs 60,07,500 in cash into her bank account during the financial year 2015-16. However, she had not filed an income tax return (ITR) for the corresponding assessment year. The Assessing Officer (AO) subsequently issued a show-cause notice under Section 148A(b) of the Income Tax Act, 1961. As the woman did not respond, the AO passed an order.

title: Rajkumari Chanu scripts history with maiden Wushu bronze at Youth Olympics Games
content: Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu created history at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games by winning India's first-ever Wushu medal, claiming bronze in the women's Changquan combined event with 18.039 points. Her achievement took India's medal tally to three, following silver in judo and bronze in swimming, marking a major milestone for Indian Wushu on the international stage.

title: 'Want Rahul vs PM Modi debate?' Cong MP runs X poll; asks BJP to make it happen
content: On Monday, Rahul had challenged the Prime Minister to an open debate on the allegations of him of becoming Prime Minister with "foreign help" saying the latter would not dare to accept it. The whole showdown began after Rahul retorted to Modi's 'Ekta Diwas' speech, in which the PM accused the opposition of turning into an "obstructionist force" (avrodh paksh).

title: Ranji: Ayush Doseja admits second-season blues after hitting season's first fifty
content: A year on from a prolific 949-run season, Ayush Doseja has faced outside noise and a string of unfortunate dismissals in the Ranji Trophy. The Delhi batter insists his confidence remains intact, credits the Bengal attack for a valuable challenge and believes patience, consistency and an attacking style will help him convert starts into big scores and push towards India A.

title: Rupali Ganguly moves Bombay high court over misuse of AI-Generated photos
content: Rupali Ganguly has recently approached the Bombay High Court regarding unauthorized use of her photographs and videos. She claims that multiple platforms and websites have used her images without consent, including adult websites featuring AI-generated morphed content. Ganguly's lawyer has requested the court to mandate the removal of objectionable content and protect her identity. The actress is recognized for her successful role in the show Anupamaa, which revitalized her career.

title: 'We are heartbroken': UEFA mourns Jesús de Miguel; police open probe
content: CD Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel, 30, has died after suffering serious injuries in a collision with Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono during a Spanish second-division match. Despite receiving emergency treatment, his condition deteriorated, and he passed away on Tuesday. UEFA has expressed its condolences and announced moments of silence at its matches, while Spanish police investigate possible involuntary manslaughter.

title: Russia gives its drones bigger antennas to beat Ukraine's jamming
content: Russia is bolstering its drone attack fleet by integrating more prominent anti-jamming antennas, which are pivotal for securing satellite-navigation signals from interference. This enhancement is meant to ensure drones adhere to their pre-programmed routes amidst Ukrainian electronic warfare efforts. Reports suggest the presence of rapid jet-powered drones that quicken attack cycles.

title: AICWA seeks intervention from PM Modi regarding the security concerns in Bollywood

The All Indian Cine Workers Association is pushing Prime Minister Narendra Modi to implement stronger security protocols for those in the film industry. The spate of violent attacks and extortion attempts on prominent stars has raised significant concerns, prompting demands for effective safeguards in Mumbai to protect its residents.

title: 'I was disappointed': Why Dhinidhi isn't celebrating her historic Youth Oly medal

Although she aimed for gold and hoped to shatter the 56-second mark, she expressed disappointment with her performance. This achievement is pivotal for Indian swimming, especially for female athletes.

title: ‘I become CM when I don’t contest elections’: Akhilesh drops hint on UP poll strategy

As the assembly elections loom, he reveals plans to reassume his Lok Sabha role, underscoring the necessity of auspicious timings for nomination submissions in Kashi. His statements showcase a creative electoral approach as he positions himself ahead of the elections.

title: Trump's torment: From draining the swamp to drowning in mid-terms?
content: As Americans head to the polls for the pivotal midterm elections, the stakes couldn't be higher for Trump's administration. Current polling trends indicate a potential shift towards Democratic control in Congress, which could complicate Trump's legislative agenda. Historically, presidents facing an opposing Congress have encountered significant roadblocks, underscoring the potential for ongoing investigations and contentious budget negotiations.

title: Footballer’s death: What next for goalie? Sanctions, possible criminal proceedings

The incident, which led to a cardiac arrest for de Miguel during the match, ended in a 2-2 draw, but Owono was issued a red card for his involvement.

title: ISSF World C'ships: India’s men win pistol team gold, women’s rifle trio bags silver

In the women's 10m air rifle team event, India secured a silver medal with a total of 1,894.4 points. Elavenil Valarivan qualified for the individual finals, aiming for an Olympic quota place.

title: Deleted from SIR draft rolls? EC says can use Form 6 for re-inclusion
content: a previous elector who seeks re-inclusion by filling form 6 will not be liable for prosecution . the declaration that the voter's name is being included in the electoral roll for the first time . no action will be taken against an elector, whose name is deleted from draft rolls .
